name: Does AEO replace the need for traditional website SEO?

mainEntity.name: Does AEO replace the need for traditional website SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, AEO does not replace traditional website SEO; rather, it complements and enhances it. Strong foundational SEO, including technical optimization, mobile-friendliness, and quality backlinks, remains crucial for overall website health and ranking. AEO builds upon this foundation by specifically structuring your content to be easily digestible and directly answerable by AI and voice search. For roofing contractors, a comprehensive digital marketing strategy integrates both SEO and AEO to maximize visibility across all search types.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO doesn't replace traditional SEO; it complements it by optimizing content for direct answers in AI and voice search, building upon a strong SEO foundation.
